# Health

`c.Health` calls the API's Health group. Health check endpoints for liveness,
readiness, and detailed status.

## Methods

| Method                           | Returns                     | Permission    | Description                         |
| -------------------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| [`Liveness(ctx)`](#liveness)     | `*Response[HealthResponse]` |               | Liveness probe.                     |
| [`Ready(ctx)`](#ready)           | `*Response[ReadyResponse]`  |               | Readiness probe.                    |
| [`Status(ctx, params)`](#status) | `*Response[StatusResponse]` | `health:read` | System status and component health. |

### Liveness

```go
func (s *HealthService) Liveness(
	ctx context.Context,
) (*Response[HealthResponse], error)
```

Liveness probe.

Returns 200 if the process is alive. No checks performed.

It sends `GET /api/health`, and needs no permission.

The examples of the method's definition:

Liveness probe, `go run health.go liveness`:

```go
resp, err := c.Health.Liveness(ctx)
```

### Ready

```go
func (s *HealthService) Ready(
	ctx context.Context,
) (*Response[ReadyResponse], error)
```

Readiness probe.

Returns 200 when the service is ready to accept traffic.

It sends `GET /api/health/ready`, and needs no permission.

The examples of the method's definition:

Readiness probe, `go run health.go ready`:

```go
resp, err := c.Health.Ready(ctx)
```

### Status

```go
func (s *HealthService) Status(
	ctx context.Context,
	params HealthStatusParams,
) (*Response[StatusResponse], error)
```

System status and component health.

Returns per-component health status with system metrics. Requires
authentication.

It sends `GET /api/health/status`, and needs the permission `health:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

System status and component health, `go run health.go status`:

```go
resp, err := c.Health.Status(ctx, client.HealthStatusParams{})
```

System status and component health, with --component agent,
`go run health.go status-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Health.Status(ctx, client.HealthStatusParams{Component: client.GetHealthStatusComponent("agent")})
```

### ConditionType

A condition that an agent or a component evaluates.

A `string`, one of `MemoryPressure`, `HighLoad`, `DiskPressure`, `DrainStuck`,
`ConsumersUnavailable`, `ProcessMemoryPressure`, `ProcessHighCPU`.

### GetHealthStatusComponent

Show only the components of this type: controller, nats or agent. The other
parts of the status stay.

A `string`, one of `controller`, `nats`, `agent`.
